item.title: Delegate Larry Kump, master of various catch phrases, has died
item.description: Kump, a Republican, served in the House from 2010 to 2014, again from 2018 to 2020 and finally 2022 to the present. He had announced plans to run again in the coming electoral cycle. The post Delegate Larry Kump, master of various catch phrases, has died appeared first on WV MetroNews.
